paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: Paper derives constraints on ALP-photon coupling from H.E.S.S. observations of PKS 2155-304 using spectral irregularity method. Main result: g_agamma < 2.1×10^-11 GeV^-1 for ALP mass between 15 neV and 60 neV (conservative limit from galaxy cluster magnetic field). Additional optimistic limit from IGMF: ~5×10^-11 GeV^-11 for ~1 neV mass. Data points represent the conservative cluster-based constraint endpoints. Limits improve CAST constraints by factor ~4 in this mass range. Method is independent of spectral shape assumptions and applies to both pseudoscalar and scalar bosons coupling to photons. | [VISION GATE B] vision notes assert the plotted axis belongs to VectorB-L/VectorBL but the declared coupling is AxionPhoton — wrong panel/curve traced | selector: text (sole candidate)
